offering_description.value: Provides outsourced insurance claims management and adjusting services for insurers, self-insured employers and legal settlement administrators. Handles claims investigation, case management and settlement on fee or contract terms, delivered by staff and independent adjusters worldwide.

primary_services.value: claims management; independent adjusting; workers' compensation case management; subrogation; legal settlement administration

customer_segment.value: B2B: property and casualty insurers, self-insured employers, insurance carriers, law firms and corporate risk managers

end_markets.value: insurance; workers' compensation; property and casualty; legal settlements; employee benefits

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for handling and managing insurance claims for clients; project or contract: contracted claims management and settlement administration programs

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in claims files from insurers and employers and sells claims handling and adjusting services back to them

geography_served.value: global: operates claims offices across many countries in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: property and casualty claims, workers' compensation claims and legal settlement administration, sharing insurer and employer customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling claims services directly to insurers, employers and law firms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: medium: state and national insurance claims-handling rules, adjuster licensing and data privacy laws
